_comment: Audit tables: stepNameList holds the step names the calling code passes to audit.record/update (a step belongs to one table only; names differing only in case are refused; a step listed nowhere is not audited), auditflag (false = write nothing for its steps), rollingSize (optional, default 10000: most rows kept; past it the oldest whole requests are deleted) and schema (optional, default audit_dev; packages.db maps only the name NOIDev to NOI_SCHEMA, so the NOI tables follow NOI_SCHEMA while this table stays in audit_dev, beside the draft RPA's rows). NOIDraftEntryAudit is shared: its first 21 steps are the draft RPA's (agents/agent_04/noi_draft_rpa, tools/run_fabric_draft.py), in run order (steers_rpa/run_audit.py; securityQuestion and securityAnswer are written from inside the STEERS login; draftOpen is the resume run's, where a new draft's draftCreate would be; the five answersVerify... steps are the verification module's); the last three are the queue endpoint's (agents/agent_04/noi_draft_queue/service.py). DDL: sql/NOIDraftEntryAudit.sql.
